plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, PLTU, MUU, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
This significantly reduces overall portfolio leverage and risk.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Reduce all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, PLTU, MUU, SPAL) to smaller, more balanced allocations.
This reduces overall leverage while maintaining some exposure to high-beta names.
Buy TECS, a strong scanner setup, to add new, quality exposure.
balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index, quality tech, and a small amount of leveraged exposure. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with reasonable growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.

Buy TECS, a strong scanner setup, to add new, high-potential exposure.
This strategy uses leverage and concentration for stretched growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretched growth, targeting ~4% per month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. This approach raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month. It rotates heavily into income/covered-call ETFs and cuts leveraged/high-beta names to near zero. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable distributions, remember that distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
